operations.title: 1245 — The Five-Site Denominator Packet Does Not Yet Serialize the Canonical Period
operations.body: The five-cycle pole-incidence packet fixes carrier support but omits the adjoint numerator or oriented simplex weights needed to serialize the canonical rational function. Landau-support closure remains valid, but creative telescoping is gated on a source-normalized canonical-form construction.

operations.title: Benincasa reports five-site canonical-period serialization gate
operations.body: Entry 1245: the 180-term five-cycle packet is denominator-incidence data, not yet a serialized canonical function. The primary source fixes Omega_C5 abstractly via its adjoint numerator/canonical residues, but our packet contains neither numerator nor oriented simplex determinant weights. Entries 1237–1244 still close Landau support because they use only poles. Picard–Fuchs work is now gated on constructing and residue-verifying the source-normalized canonical form; no new carrier datum is indicated.
